title: Eddoboozi Nga Liwakanya Obuzito Obw'obulimba
intro: Omwoyo omwesigwa gwakuzibwa mu basuubuzi n’abasuubuzi mu nsi minzaani mwe zaali ziserengese n’ebipimo ne bifunzibwa. Omuntu ono ssekinnoomu yayimirira yekka ng’awakanya obutali bwesimbu bw’eggwanga lyonna, ng’abayita mu bwenkanya n’okusinza Katonda Omu ow’Amazima. Wadde obubaka bwali bulambulukufu ate ng’omulanga gwa bwenkanya, abantu baagaana okuwuliriza era baayolekedde enkomerero ey’amaanyi. Osobola okuzuula omubaka ono ow’ekitiibwa okuva mu Quran?
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’omubaka eri abantu abaali beetoolodde eby’obusuubuzi n’ebyobusuubuzi.
Abantu bange baali bamanyiddwa mu nsi yonna olw’okuwaayo ebipimo ebimpi n’okufera mu buzito.
Era baatiisa abatambuze ku luguudo ne basaasaanya obuli bw’enguzi mu nsi yonna.
Nabakubiriza okusinza Allah yekka n’okubeera abeesimbu ddala mu nkolagana yaabwe n’abalala.
Baagaana obubaka bwange ne batiisatiisa okungoba n’abo abakkiriza nange mu nsi.
Allah yantaasa n’abagoberezi bange olw’okusaasira kwe, ate abasobya ne bakwatibwa ekibonerezo eky’amaanyi.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
